candidate_evidence.quote: study of sintilimab (one anti-PD-1 antibody same as nivolumab approved in China) plus bevacizumab administered in a low dosage schedule

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: participants with a clinical relapse or circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA)-level relapse of glioblastoma (GBM)

role_evidence.quote: Sintilimab (One Anti-PD-1 Antibody) Plus Low-dose Bevacizumab for ctDNA-level-relapse and Clinical-relapse Glioblastoma
plus bevacizumab administered in a low dosage schedule
Both cohorts will receive the same study drug sintilimab 200mg and bevacizumab 3mg/kg every 3 weeks.

agents.drug_class_hint: anti-VEGF monoclonal antibody, established GBM therapy given at low dose

biomarkers.biomarker_other: tumour in situ fluid (TISF) ctDNA-level relapse

source_quote.quote: Subjects with ctDNA-level-relapse glioblastoma before clinical relapse, determined according to the dynamics of TISF ctDNA.
To evaluate the correlative biomarkers based on TISF ctDNA.

coder_notes: Registered intervention name says 'Tislelizumab plus Bevacizumab' but the description, title and summary all say sintilimab (brand TYVYT); coded sintilimab. The single registered intervention was split into its two drugs. Bevacizumab is given at the same low dose in both cohorts; coded established_therapy_experiment because the low-dose schedule is named in the title (rule 6 exception R2); soc_backbone is the alternative, neither is a candidate. ctDNA-level relapse in TISF defines Cohort 1 (enrichment), not mechanistically linked to sintilimab. Outcome text mentions durvalumab (apparent copy error).
